description: This file defines the NotificationsStore class, which manages local notification data with persistence using SharedPreferences. It handles storing, retrieving, updating, and clearing notification items, providing LiveData observers for UI components.

classes.name: NotificationsStore
classes.description: A class that manages local notifications, providing methods to add, mark as read, mark all as read, clear notifications, and observe changes via LiveData. It persists data using SharedPreferences with JSON encoding/decoding.

methods.name: observeNotifications
methods.description: Returns LiveData for the list of notifications, allowing UI components to observe changes.

methods.name: observeUnreadCount
methods.description: Returns LiveData for the count of unread notifications.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Adds a new notification to the list and updates observers and storage.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a specified notification as read based on its ID.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Removes all notifications from storage and resets LiveData.

methods.name: loadFromDisk
methods.description: Loads notifications from SharedPreferences, decoding JSON and updating LiveData.

methods.name: persistAndPublish
methods.description: Encodes the notifications list into JSON, saves it to SharedPreferences, and updates LiveData.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Serializes a list of NotificationItem objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a list of NotificationItem objects.
